name: Stories of Deir el Qamar
description: A guided walk through the stone lanes, old souk, and historic mansions of Deir el Qamar, with stories about the town's role in Mount Lebanon's history told by a local guide.
inclusions: Local guide
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Route includes old stone streets and stairs; suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Chouf Nature Escape
description: A guided nature outing on forest trails in the Chouf highlands, focused on cedar and oak landscapes, viewpoints, and local plant knowledge.
suitability: Active visitors; nature lovers; moderate fitness
inclusions: Local nature guide
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Trail difficulty and accessibility are not verified.
food_notes: No meals included. Visitors should ask the team about water and snacks.

name: Taste of the Village
description: A hands-on traditional cooking session hosted in a village home, preparing classic Lebanese dishes such as mana'eesh and seasonal mezze with a local host.
inclusions: Cooking session with a local host; eating the dishes prepared
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Indoor home setting; access details must be confirmed.
food_notes: Menu and ingredients vary by season and host. Dietary suitability (allergies, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free) is not documented and must be confirmed by the team.

name: Heritage Through Time
description: A full-day heritage itinerary in and around Byblos covering the old port, the historic souk, and archaeological layers spanning many civilizations, with guided interpretation.
inclusions: Licensed heritage guide; site entry tickets are not documented as included
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Includes walking on uneven historic ground; suitability must be confirmed.

name: Coastal Charms of Batroun
description: A relaxed coastal discovery of Batroun's old town, Phoenician sea wall, small harbour, and seaside lanes, with free time by the sea.
inclusions: Local guide
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Mountain Village Retreat
description: An overnight stay in a mountain village guesthouse near the Qadisha Valley, combining village life, quiet landscapes, and time with local hosts.
inclusions: One night in a partner guesthouse with a local host
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Guesthouse access and room arrangements must be confirmed.
food_notes: Meal arrangements are not documented and must be confirmed by the team.

name: Beirut Street Food Walk
description: An evening-friendly walk through Beirut neighbourhoods tasting street food classics such as falafel, man'oushe, ka'ak, and Lebanese sweets at small family-run shops.
suitability: Food lovers; first-time visitors; solo travellers
inclusions: Local food guide; tastings at each stop
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Involves city walking; suitability must be confirmed.
food_notes: Tastings vary by shop. Dietary suitability (allergies, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free) is not documented and must be confirmed by the team.

name: Baalbek: City of the Sun
description: A full-day heritage visit to Baalbek's monumental Roman temple complex, with guided interpretation of the temples of Bacchus and Jupiter and time in the surrounding town.
inclusions: Licensed heritage guide; site entry tickets are not documented as included
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Large archaeological site with steps and uneven ground; suitability must be confirmed.

name: Zahle Vineyards and Arak Tasting
description: A visit to family vineyards around Zahle to learn how Lebanese wine and arak are made, followed by a guided tasting with local mezze.
suitability: Adults only (legal drinking age); couples; food and wine lovers
inclusions: Vineyard visit; guided wine and arak tasting; light mezze
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.
food_notes: Includes alcohol. Non-alcoholic options and dietary suitability are not documented and must be confirmed by the team.

name: Qadisha Valley Monasteries Hike
description: A guided full-day hike into the Qadisha Valley (Valley of the Saints), passing rock-cut hermitages and historic monasteries along the valley floor.
suitability: Experienced walkers; good fitness; nature and history lovers
inclusions: Mountain guide
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Steep descents and ascents; not suitable for visitors with limited mobility unless confirmed by the team.
food_notes: No meals included. Visitors should ask the team about water and packed lunch.

name: Cedars of God and Bcharre
description: A visit to the ancient Cedars of God grove above Bcharre, followed by a walk through the town where poet Gibran Khalil Gibran was born.
inclusions: Local guide
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Tripoli Old Souks and Sweets
description: A guided walk through Tripoli's Mamluk-era souks, khans, and hammams, ending with a tasting of the city's famous traditional sweets.
inclusions: Local guide; sweets tasting
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Busy, narrow market lanes; suitability must be confirmed.
food_notes: Sweets tasting included. Ingredients and allergy suitability (for example nuts and dairy) are not documented and must be confirmed.

name: Tyre: Ruins by the Sea
description: A full-day visit to Tyre's Roman hippodrome, colonnaded streets, and seaside ruins, followed by time at the old fishing harbour.
inclusions: Licensed heritage guide; site entry tickets are not documented as included
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Open archaeological sites with uneven ground; suitability must be confirmed.

name: Sidon Sea Castle and Old Souk
description: A guided visit to Sidon's Crusader sea castle and the old souk, including a stop at a traditional soap-making heritage space.
inclusions: Local guide
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Jeita and Harissa Discovery
description: A half-day outing combining the limestone caves of Jeita Grotto with panoramic views of Jounieh Bay from Harissa.
inclusions: Local guide; site entry tickets are not documented as included
season: Year-round; parts of the grotto may close seasonally
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Pottery and Craft Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop with a family of traditional potters in a Metn village, shaping a small piece on the wheel and learning about Lebanese craft heritage.
inclusions: Workshop with a local artisan; materials
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Indoor workshop; access details must be confirmed.

name: Jezzine Waterfall and Pine Forest
description: A gentle nature outing to the Jezzine waterfall and the surrounding pine forests, with a stop in the town known for its traditional handcrafted cutlery.
inclusions: Local guide
season: Year-round; waterfall flow is strongest in winter and spring
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Beiteddine Palace and Shouf Cedars
description: A full day combining the 19th-century Beiteddine Palace and its courtyards with a walk among the cedars of the Shouf Biosphere Reserve.
suitability: First-time visitors; history and nature lovers
inclusions: Local guide; site entry tickets are not documented as included
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Suitability must be confirmed by the team.

name: Snowshoeing in the Cedars
description: A guided winter snowshoe walk through snowy slopes and cedar landscapes above Bcharre, suitable for beginners with reasonable fitness.
suitability: Active visitors; beginners with reasonable fitness
inclusions: Mountain guide; snowshoe rental
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Physically demanding in snow; suitability must be confirmed.

name: Batroun Sunset Kayak
description: A guided sea-kayaking outing along the Batroun coastline at sunset, paddling past the old sea wall and small coves.
inclusions: Kayak guide; kayak and paddle
accessibility_notes: Not documented. Requires comfort on the water; swimming ability and safety arrangements must be confirmed by the team.
